cards.title: Opening
cards.applicability: Choosing the initial commander, reconnaissance, battles, income, construction and useful economic expansion.

cards.title: Global strategy
cards.applicability: Initial or revised victory course: early offense versus economic expansion, especially on large maps or long routes; milestones and readiness to attack.

cards.title: Development
cards.applicability: Economic expansion and conversion into military advantage: income payback, construction, affordable growth, recruitment and delivery bottlenecks.

cards.title: Offensive operation
cards.applicability: Choosing objectives, routes and follow-up; comparing actors again after losses or troop transfers.

cards.title: Main army idle
cards.applicability: Distinguishing intentional defense from blocked routes, execution and unsupported goals.

cards.title: Recovery
cards.applicability: Own retreat/surrender and urgent tavern recovery; commander loss, mana, delivery and next operation.

cards.title: Defense
cards.applicability: Town exposure, insufficient defenders or unbounded opposition; preserving garrison protection across offensive revisions.

cards.title: Town after capture
cards.applicability: After capture/completed hold: economic and production value, development, delivery, departure, garrison, interception and renewed defense.

cards.title: Exploration
cards.applicability: Choosing viewpoints, sites and passages; end-turn scouting exposure and reassessment after scout loss.

cards.title: Finish the game
cards.applicability: Choosing a concrete elimination operation, decisive attack or town denial instead of recurring local gains.
